title: Witch's Cosmic Ritual
description: A purple-skinned witch with white hair stands at a stone fountain altar surrounded by red and pink peonies, holding a glowing orb containing a green frog and floating hearts. Above her, an orange dragon emerges from a swirling purple and yellow cosmic portal, with floating potion bottles, scrolls, candles, and roses against a starry black background.
prompt: A mystical scene featuring a purple-skinned witch with white hair in a dark robe standing at a stone fountain altar covered in red and pink peonies. She holds a glowing blue orb with a green frog and floating hearts inside. An orange dragon flies out from a swirling purple and yellow cosmic vortex in the night sky. Floating around are potion bottles, ancient scrolls, candles, and roses. Starry black background with magical atmosphere.
